Vector Bay Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to StarTop Railway Cadence Line (Vector Bay Station) and Vector Bay Cable Car (Ko Shan Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station, as well as Vector Bay, is named after the mathematical concept of Vector.
  • The building materials of this station alludes to Adobe Illustrator.
  • Platform 2 of this station is 224m long, and the west end of the platform is also slightly curved.

History[]

  • November 7 2016: This station began services.
  • June 29 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[2]
  • April 29 2020: Exit A3 is added to this station to connect to Vector Mount Bus Terminus.[3]
  • October 31 2024: The Station Title of this station is announced through the monthly calender.[4]

title: Veloduct
safeHtml:
Veloducts is a system of Commuter Railways ran by Nazca Railway. It is established on March 25 2016. Currently, there are 10 Veloducts in Operation, with two being planned, and one being merged with another line.

Contents

  • 1 Naming
  • 2 Lines
  • 3 Stations
  • 4 Other facts
  • 5 Citations and References

Naming[]

While most of the Veloducts are named after "NATO Alphabets", there are also some exceptions to it as follows:[1]

  • Echo → Epsilon Line (The Original Echo Line was abolished)
  • Foxtrot → Fox Line

Other facts[]

  • Edward Island Checkpoint was originally planned as an emergency stop for Alpha Line instead of a station for Bravo Line.
  • The section between Seat River and Compass Island of Alpha Line and Bravo Line shares tracks with New Edward Line.
  • Alpha Line is the first existing Veloduct to be built and established.
  • The section between Comp Ward and Metropolis of Alpha Line has the longest interstation distance for Los Sengas Division Veloduct at 12.43km.
  • The section between City Origin and Flask East of Bravo Line shares the same structure with Route 2.
  • The section between Raytree and Prosand of Bravo Line (Originally Echo Line) shares tracks with Stadium Line.
  • Bravo Line has emergency stops at Prosand and Calmé.
  • Charlie Line passes above Numpool Station and through Miner North Station.
  • Charlie Line has the longest slope near South Bay Station.
  • Charlie Line has an emergency stop at Cyan Loop.
  • The originally planned Mayler Airport Station had to be abolished and demolished since Delta Line has to cross under Mayler Airport.
  • Due to the establishment of Delta Line, Jayler Station Platforms 3 and 4 have been reassigned from Arcgo Line short-distance termini platforms this line.
  • The Old Echo Line was the first veloduct to be established.
  • The Old Echo Line merged with Bravo Line, and is the first line to be merged.
  • The Current Echo Line was established as Epsilon Line prior to renaming during Pre-Season 4 Phase 3.
  • Fox Line uses Metropolis Terminal Phase IV and Middle Island Station Platforms 2 and 3, which were originally for Stadium Line short-distance trains.
  • While Rover Down Checkpoint reserved Platforms 5 and 6 for Golf Line, they were not used until S3E12.
  • Hotel Line and Juliett Line were originally named Hopps Line and Judy Line respectively, but were renamed to the current names due to historical reasons. The same applies for Zephyr Line, which was originally named Ranger Line.
  • Lima Line has reserved platforms at Metropolis Terminal and Old Brightland Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station alludes to Shek Mun Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[2]

History[]

  • July 14 2016: This Station began services.
  • October 10 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • June 14 2020: Exits B and D are added to this station.[4]
  • February 4 2024: The Platforms of this station are extended from 152m to 204m.
  • March 20 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

title: Vermillion Stone
safeHtml:
Vermillion Stone is one of the Sub-Districts of Winsol. It is located at the West Side of North Winsol, and its District Code is 29-18.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing
    • 2.2 Home Ownership Scheme
    • 2.3 Private Housing

    • 3.1 Major Roads
  • 4 Fun Facts

History[]

There has been two possible sources regarding the name of Vermillion Stone. One of them has to do with the Developer of this District starting to pick up an interest in Cantopop in 2019, and the other was the fact that vermillion-colored text appeared on rocks in this district.

Vermillion Stone was not a part of the Asylum New Town, but as the developer of Asylum also began developing Winsol, the area in Winsol to the north of Route 18 is now seen as a part of Asylum New Town. Vermillion Stone is the west section of the Extension, and is the most populated District among the Extension.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station has the first four-floored elevator which supports transportation to three other floors at once in Los Sengas, as well as the only one in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. A similar four-floored elevator has been built at Hillly Strings Station of Element Hub Transit more than 7.5 years after the completion of this station.

History[]

  • December 7 2016: This station began services alongside Flask Line, but Arcgo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 29 2016: Arcgo Line extends from Ingress Beach Station to this station.
  • June 2 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[2]

Fun Facts[]

  • As Queen Elizabeth II, the former Queen of the United Kingdom, passed away on September 8 2022, shortly before the construction of this station, it has been built with a purple color scheme to allude to the fact that purple, due to its difficulty in extraction, is considered as a color for the royalty.[2] Words of remembrance has also been written on the Station Signs of this station.

History[]

  • September 15 2022: This station completed construction.[3][4]
  • September 16 2022: This station began services.
  • July 2 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Vincere Road Station is a station on Swift Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 201 (Vincere Road NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station alludes to Venus Street Station of Sava Line with regards that the fifth station counting upwards from the starting station of its respective line at the time of construction is also a street name.[2][3]
  • The V-Shaped Skylight at the Platform level of this station corresponds to the word Victory.[4]

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was constructed in a terrain similar to that of Silver Plateau Station, and Light Gray Wool would have been used to allude to that station, as Light Gray Wool was already used for Gentle Island Station, Gray Wool is used for this station instead.[4]
  • This station is the last of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a math teacher who taught Railway Builder for a year at SKH Chan Young Secondary School, with the other two stations being Gentle Island Station and Harvest River Station.[5][6]
  • This Station incorporates elements from previous "East Ring Line Loop Completion Series" Stations, and is the first station in Nazca Railway to incorporate elements from previous stations. The reference points are as follows:[7]
    • Comet Terrace Station: High Floor Height of Mezzanine Ceiling and Square Ceiling Decorations.
    • Weaving Plate Station: Train Entry Area, Semi-Circular Ceiling of East and West Concourses.
    • Gentle Island Station: Three-Storey Bookshelf next to Los Sengas Coffee.
    • Harvest River Station: Two patches of farmlands at Northeast, Northwest, Southeast and Southwest corners at the Transfer Passageways.
  • The Stained Glass behind the Platforms and the Iron Bars behind the Tracks would later be incorporated at Torrent South Station.
  • The Confined Space between the Stadium Line, Bravo Line Platforms would later be incorporated at Dune Ocean Station.
  • A Station Notice is present at this station prior to the extension of Stadium Line and Bravo Line to this station.
  • The connection of Stadium Line and Bravo Line to this Station further assisted in the connectivity of New Edward Line, Arcgo Line, Luxter Line, Flask Line, Ingress Line and Charlie Line to this line.
  • A grave and a memorial of the now-deceased main character from Part 1 the Heroes of Los Sengas Series is erected near Exit B of this station.
  • This Station is chosen as the Fireworks Display Venue in the sixth anniversary of Project Nazca.

History[]

  • September 14 2017: The Platforms and Main Concourse Structure of This Station completed construction.[8]
  • September 15 2017: The Main Structure and Connecting Passageways of This Station completed construction.[9]
  • September 16 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line, but Stadium Line and Bravo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • November 23 2017: Stadium Line and Bravo Line extends from Spade Valley Station and Pi Lake Station to this station respectively.

Virtue Plateau Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Glacier. Passengers may also use this station to change to Royal Railway Eastern Line (Virtue Plateau Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, alongside Qoser Coast Station and Royal Mount Station, are built in tribute to Nabela Qoser, a former Hong Kong-based journalist and broadcaster.
  • The section between Qoser Coast Station and this station adopts a "Bridge Core" design similar to that of Oasis Bay Line.

History[]

  • October 24 2020: This station completed construction.[2]
  • October 25 2020: This station began services.
  • June 9 2022: Exit C is added to this station.[3]

Description[]

Vision Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through Twenty-Second Continent.

This line is represented by Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 32.

Currently, this route is 3.76 km long, with a total of 3 stations.

Up Extend Southwest from Lorepine Station to Summer Point Gateway, where it interchanges once again with Akashi Line and permanently terminates in the Up Direction. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Up Extend along the Coastline of Twenty-Second Continent to Summer Point Gateway, where it permanently terminates in the Up Direction. TBC

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line mainly serves the south of Twenty-Second Continent.

Fun Facts[]

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built with the mindset of Extraterristrial Visitors in mind.[2]
  • Despite being an elevated station, the platforms and concourses of this station are completely sealed off.
  • Route 14 passes directly to the south of this station.

History[]

  • June 13 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • March 7 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • October 4 2024: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[3]
  • June 13 2026: This station completed expansion of the Daybreaker Line Part. At the same day, it completed expansion.
  • June 15 2026: Daybreaker Line extends from New Glade Station to this station.

title: Wah Tin
safeHtml:
Wah Tin is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is the Northernmost Sub-District of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-01.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Future Development
  • 3 Housing
    • 3.1 Public Housing
    • 3.2 Home Ownership Scheme
    • 3.3 Private Sector Participation Scheme
    • 3.4 Private Housing
  • 4 Transport
    • 4.1 Nazca Railway
    • 4.2 Major Roads
  • 5 Citations and References

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from the deceased Grandfather of the Developer of Asylum who passed away a few years ago. Since then, the Developer has always wanted to use this name at cities that he constructed, and eventually this name is used to the northeast of Arctic Sea to symbolize prosperity.

Prior to the relocation of the Asylum City Center from Arctic Sea to Brighton Hall, Wah Tin was planned to contain Public Housing Settlements within a close vicinity to the Town Center. However, Public Housing in Wah Tin is now considered rural.

During development, Barode Cave, a natural landscape within the vicinity, had been briefly removed, but was ultimately restored due to excessive backlash. Currently, there are plans to transform the cave into a park that is situated near Barode Cave Station and a Bus Terminus.

The Developer originally anticipated Arcgo Line to turn east to the north of Arctic Sea, and reach Coopol after going deep into this district, while Coopol Line would run parallel to Route 3 to the east of Wah Tin before proceeding to Coopol Station. However, after Nazca Railway released plans for the Ingress Continent in the 2024 Development Plans, this plan was scrapped, and the decision was made to expand the size of public housing in Wah Tin. As a result, over 60% of this Sub-District is Public House, and this also reflects the fact that real-life Public Housing Projects such as Fu Shin Estate, Fu Heng Estate and Wah Ming Estate tend to be situated far away from Railway Stations.

In the Original Plans, Public Housing in Wah Tin are few and far between, namely Kam Wing Estate, Kam Cheong Estate and Kam Tai Estate. However, due to scenic and environmental concerns, Density of the Public Housing have increased, which resulted in estates such as Kam Heng Estate and Kam Yiu Estate.

In order to Commemorate the Relative of the Developer of Asylum, all Public Housing in Wah Tin starts with the word "Kam", and all Home Ownership Scheme Housing ends with the word "Wah".

Future Development[]

There has been collaborations between the Developers of Asylum and Coopol regarding the development of the Lucky Pit Area, and more public housing may possibly be built to the north of Tai Hong Street. If the plans comes to fruition, "Kam Shing Estate", "Kam Yan Estate", "Kam Hong Estate" and "Kam Chung Estate" will be built.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station alludes to Nut Pond Station in Terracept Division. However, the color scheme of this station is different from that of Nut Pond Station.[4]
  • This station is designed to be the mirrored version of Firewood Point Station with regards that, while Firewood Point Station is located beneath a roundabout, with the concourse being above the platform, this station is located above a roundabout, with the concourse being below the platform. Moreover, Firewood Point Station and this station also has three exits with the same exit distribution,, with Exits A and C being located along the same road.
  • The Station control room of this station is located beneath the concourse and is visible from the concourse above.

History[]

  • August 29 2020: This station began services.
  • May 30 2021: Exit B of this station completed reconstruction and exit naming.[5]
  • August 20 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Description[]

Wanderer Line is one of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through Oasis Bay and Jupiter.

This line is represented by Dark Purple on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 35.

Currently, this route is 18.05 km long, with a total of 6 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S3E15: Smelting Bay - Markost

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Westwards from the Zero Station of Smelting Bay Station to Teraleros to the west through The Great Liberty Bridge, connecting with Urban Line and Minecraft Line in the process. Completed
(Chapter: S3E15)

Districts Served[]

  • Oasis Bay
  • Jupiter

Fun Facts[]

  • The section between Cranerock Mount and Markost of this line shares structure with The Great Liberty Bridge, and with an interstation distance of 10.18 km, this section has replaced the Internal Sea East to Flask East section of Flask Line as the section with the longest non-express train, non-veloduct interstation distance of any Standard Railway Nazca Railway line in Los Sengas Division.

Wardring Line was the eleventh line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Curly Braces and East Tree Bay, and had a total of 11 stations. It was established alongside Curvy Creek Station on July 24 2014. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Wardring Line was the eleventh District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled along the south coast of Vertin Peninsula in an east-west orientation.

This line was represented by the Lavender Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 10.

At the time of its closure, this route was 9.265 km long, with a total of 11 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • As the name of this line suggests, this line was planned to be the first ring line in Terracept Division, with known plans to extend to Continent Line Golden Oak Station as reserved platforms for this line were seen there. However, due to the closure of Terracept Division, the plans never came to fruition.

History[]

  • July 24 2014: Curvy Creek - Edward Hill
  • August 31 2014: Curly Braces - East Tree Bay

Fun Facts[]

  • Starting from this station and Yowah North Station, all Stations in the "East Ring Line Loop Completion Series" Uses Polished Andesite coupled with a colored wool. Yellow Wool is used in this station as Yellow is one of the Warm Colors.[2]

History[]

  • August 19 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.[3]
  • July 4 2021: This station completed exit naming.[4]
  • September 30 2022: This station completed expansion of the Phoenix Line section.[5]
  • October 1 2022: Phoenix Line extends from Stardust Station to this station.
  • December 31 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station alludes to "Water Series" Stations (Wathill Station, Watorest Station, Watesert Station, Watombine Station, Watiple Station and Watsnow Station) in Terracept Division, as well as Watloop Island in West Metropolis Archipelago.

History[]

  • July 20 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • July 23 2015: Daring Line extends from Congorge Station to this station. Daring Line is established.
  • June 9 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • March 9 2017: This station completed expansion of the Fox Line section.[5]
  • March 10 2017: Fox Line extends from Middle Island Station to this station. Fox Line is established.
  • February 16 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • October 12 2018: Services for Fox Line are suspended due to external structure appearing at the Fox Line section between this station and Middle Island Station.[7]
  • January 16 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]

Watloop Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is located to the south of Beam Island, the northeast of Brain Island, and is one of the islands that are under development.
